about: The SHA-256 of each official archive of the Typst that typst-version.txt pins, by version and by archive name (https://github.com/typst/typst/releases/download/v<version>/<archive>). tests/bootstrap.py installs no Typst whose archive is not listed here with the hash it computes. Computed on 2026-10-10 from the archives GitHub serves; a new version is recorded by `python tests/bootstrap.py --record-hashes <version>` (docs/conventions/testing.md §11ter).
